correctness.rationale: The exact within-epoch compositions are T2∘T1(x)=t x+h²bδ and T1∘T2(x)=t x−h²aδ with t=(1−ha)(1−hb)∈(0,1). A bounded iid affine perpetuity gives unique stationary mean h²δ((a+b)p−a)/(1−t) and variance h⁴δ²(a+b)²p(1−p)/(1−t²). Differentiation gives strict E′′=4h⁴δ²t(a+b)²/[(1−t)²(1+t)]>0 and the clipped minimizer. Equality of the free minimizer to an endpoint gives τ=|a−b|/(max+3min), with monotone t(h) furnishing a unique h_c; at a=b p=1/2. Expanding h→0 gives uniform Θ(h²) vs optimal Θ(h³) for a≠b. Checked exact rational stationary moments, 4-epoch full path enumeration and boundary choices independently.
